emails.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 427.22 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5,870,003 over the term.
3. Basis: You write that your base prices are frozen. Our current price is EUR 412.74; EUR 438.21 is an increase of 6.2% on it. Under a price freeze we would expect today's price to continue - our proposal already accepts most of that increase. Our recent orders for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 were at 412.74 per 1 (po:4500014351-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014465-10). Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per 1 (cost:350020).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13,740 units, about EUR 5,870,003. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
